scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: From Ranked Documents to Reliable Contexts: An Answer-Oriented Context Construct Framework for AI Search
papers.authors: Yunfei Zhong, Yinqiong Cai, Lixin Su, Haosheng Qian, Lixin Zou, Yixing Fan, Sheng Xu, Jiafeng Guo, Daiting Shi, Jingzhou He
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.23354v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Traditional Web search follows a human-facing paradigm in which users inspect ranked documents and synthesize information themselves. In AI Search, retrieved documents instead serve as inputs to a generation model, shifting the retrieval objective from ranking documents by Search Satisfaction to constructing reliable context for correct answer generation. We formulate this shift as answer-oriented context construction through a three-stage framework: (1) Answer Support identifies candidate documents that contribute information to answer generation; (2) Content Trustworthiness assesses whether this information provides a reliable basis for correct answers from source, temporal, and factual perspectives; and (3) Context Organization selects, consolidates, and structures retained information under a finite context budget for consistent and robust generation. We further develop an industrial workflow spanning prior and posterior optimiza
papers.summary: 论文把 AI 搜索的检索目标扩展为答案支持、内容可信和上下文组织三个阶段，并给出百度工业实现。文档压缩为可离线缓存的瓶颈表示，在线按查询评分；答案支持排序升级使答案通过率增加 4.8 个百分点，抽取式内容精简的人评净收益为 8.9%。各组件增益对应独立基线，不应相加。
papers.key_insight: 对社区 UGC 搜索，可分别标注“主题相关”和“能支撑答案”，用主题匹配但缺少有效信息的帖子构造难负例。问答入口还应保留原始出处，按问题要点组织互补证据；内容时间与发布时间需要分开判断。论文未披露完整训练规模和延迟数据，应先验证短文本场景收益，再投入压缩排序器。

papers.title: Parameterized Dense-Sparse Fusion for Hybrid Retrieval: Tuning a Rank-Score Mix on BEIR SciFact with Qdrant
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.22770v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: We study a parameterized hybrid ranker that fuses a dense embedding list and a sparse lexical list. The method has a small, explicit parameter vector: a dense prior $\alpha \in [0,1]$, a score-versus-rank mix $\lambda \in [0,1]$, an RRF smoothing parameter $\kappa > 0$, optional list-geometry coefficients that move $\alpha$ per query, and a router margin $\tau$ that can turn sparse search off. We grid-search those ranges on SciFact train (809 queries) and freeze the chosen values on SciFact test (300). The tuned rank-score mix ($\alpha = 0.8$, $\lambda = 0.75$, $\kappa = 20$) reaches 0.753 nDCG@10 and 0.889 recall@10, outperforming dense BGE (0.742 / 0.871) and equal-weight RRF (0.707 nDCG@10) on that test split. A list-conditioned $\alpha$ adds +0.0006 nDCG; a sparse-off router is rejected by the same train split (any $\tau$ that skipped approximately 50% of queries lost nDCG). These coefficients are dataset-specific. Equal RRF with
papers.summary: 研究在 Qdrant 中组合 BGE 稠密召回和 BM42 稀疏召回，通过训练集搜索稠密权重、分数与名次混合比例及 RRF 平滑参数。SciFact 的 809 条训练查询用于选参，300 条测试查询上 nDCG@10 为 0.753，高于稠密基线 0.742 和等权 RRF 的 0.707；20 个独立检索单元中有 16 个超过稠密基线。
papers.key_insight: UGC 短文本召回可以保留稀疏通道补充实体、型号和罕见词，再用独立验证集校准融合权重。值得复用的是搜索参数范围和冻结后测试的流程，不能照搬 SciFact 的 0.8 权重。动态权重仅增加约 0.0006 nDCG，跳过稀疏召回也未通过质量约束，优先实现简单、可审计的静态融合。

papers.title: GroundedGEO: Auditing the Evidence Gap in Generative Search Rankings
papers.authors: Yihan Xia, Huiling Fan, Kangrong Zhong, Taotao Wang
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.25189v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Generative search systems rank products and services for consequential decisions, and publishers can cheaply make candidate text look relevant. Yet evidence status is not a text property but a claim-evidence relation: text-only rankers and defenses cannot separate honest detailed content from fabricated detail, creating an identifiability gap. We audit this gap with an evidence-paired benchmark (50 e-commerce queries, 1,950 cases) and a claim-level reranker, GroundedGEO, that penalizes query-relevant claims lacking support in a supplied packet. Matched rich variants control format and volume; packet twins add attestations at fixed text, while thinned packets withdraw them. On the frozen listwise ranker Qwen2.5-7B, unsupported-rich variants show significant normalized rank gain over clean candidates (+0.065 to +0.092 across claim profiles, Holm-corrected), while supported and neutral controls do not; the effect is model-dependent (margina
papers.summary: GroundedGEO 用 50 个电商查询、1950 个配对案例审计生成式搜索中虚构细节带来的排名收益，并根据声明与证据关系实施重排。在理想证据标签下，无支持内容进入前三的比例由 0.65 降到 0.43；但所有自动判断器均未通过基于 370 条人工声明的可靠性门槛，结果不能视为自动防御已可部署。
papers.key_insight: 社区内容排序不能把描述丰富、措辞专业直接当作可信度。可借鉴固定文本、只改变证据支持的配对评测，测量排序器是否真正利用证据；同时分别监控虚假内容压制率和真实帖子误伤率。证据缺失与内容错误必须区分，尤其是缺少外链的原创 UGC，避免把理想标签效果外推到线上自动审核。

papers.title: ReFilter: Bridging Embeddings and LLM Filtering for Similar Mobile App Retrieval
papers.authors: Buthayna AlMulla, Maram Assi, Safwat Hassan
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.25306v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Retrieving similar mobile applications (apps) is essential for researchers, developers, and end-users. Researchers use similarity detection to study app ecosystems and trends, developers for competitor analysis, and end-users for focused app recommendations. Existing approaches rely on embedding-based retrieval, which captures semantic similarity but fails to identify functionally similar apps. To our knowledge, no prior work has applied large language model (LLM)-based filtering to this task, due to the high computational cost of evaluating large numbers of app pairs. To address this gap, we propose ReFilter, a hybrid framework that first Retrieves semantically related candidate apps using embeddings and then applies LLM-based contextual Filtering to identify true functionally similar apps with higher precision. This design balances efficiency and accuracy, achieving an F1-score of 90% for retrieving similar apps. By improving the relev
papers.summary: ReFilter 面向相似移动应用检索，指出语义向量接近不等于功能相似。系统先用 embedding 召回候选，再由 LLM 结合上下文过滤功能不匹配的应用，将昂贵判断限制在候选集合内；作者报告相似应用检索 F1 达到 90%。当前已核实摘要，但 HTML 全文不可用，样本构成、对照模型和线上成本仍需进一步核验。
papers.key_insight: 对社区搜索，可将相似主题与真实需求满足拆成召回和精筛两个目标，例如同样讨论手机的帖子未必回答具体故障。优先在少量召回结果上验证功能或意图过滤，并保留原始候选以分析误删；F1 90% 来自应用场景，不能当作 UGC 的预计收益，也不应据此推断在线延迟符合要求。

papers.title: Which Reranking Conclusions Survive the Answer Interface? A Prospective Finite-Orbit Audit
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.26250v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Rerankers are increasingly evaluated through downstream language-model answers. This raises a retrieval-measurement question: if only the reader's answer interface changes, should we reach the same conclusion about BM25 versus BGE-v2-m3? We prospectively audit their claim-paired effect on RAGuard and FEVER with four readers. Retrieval policies, evidence, claims, and context depth remain fixed while semantic-to-label binding, A/B versus X/Y vocabulary, and option order form eight task-equivalent interfaces. We ask whether the estimated retrieval-policy effect, its ordering, or selection value changes. None of the six confirmatory settings showed statistically certified interface variation above the prespecified 0.015 materiality threshold, and none showed a certified reversal of the BM25-BGE ordering. Selector disagreement reaches 33.5% in one environment, yet none of eight environments establishes the prespecified material held-out value
papers.summary: 论文固定查询、证据和检索策略，只改变答案标签绑定、词汇和顺序，以 8 种等价接口比较 BM25 与 BGE 重排。6 个确认性设置均未证实超过 0.015 阈值的接口效应，也未证实排序优劣反转；某环境选择器分歧达 33.5%，但并未证明有实质留出收益差异。首发于 8 月，本次 RSS 公告不代表新发表。
papers.key_insight: 用 LLM 评判社区检索结果时，应把模型平均效果、标签接口稳定性、方案优劣和实际选择收益分别报告。可对相同结果集枚举标签顺序，再采用平均值和区间，降低单一提示格式影响。该研究的主要发现是未证实广泛不稳定，不能反向宣传成“重排结论普遍失效”，也不能把不显著等同于完全等价。

papers.title: Semantic Candidate-Job Matching: A Comparative Evaluation of Dense Embedding Models in Hybrid Retrieval
papers.authors: Sai Yashwant, Siddhartha Jain, Anurag Dubey, Samaroha Chatterjee, Gantala Thulsiram
papers.abstract: Abstract: This paper presents a comparative evaluation of dense embedding models for semantic candidate-job matching in high-volume staffing workflows. Incoming job descriptions are converted into structured English search text and language-specific keywords through LLM-based parsing, and candidate profiles are indexed as semantically enriched resume representations. We evaluate EmbeddingGemma (base) against EmbeddingGemma fine-tuned with Cached Multiple Negatives Ranking Loss (MNRL) within a unified hybrid retrieval pipeline that fuses vector similarity and full-text relevance via reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), and benchmark both against the MPNet model on a batch comparative evaluation dataset scored through the deployed job-candidate matching scoring pipeline. We further document, with mathematical detail, the broader set of contrastive fine-tuning objectives considered during model development (including AnglE/CoSENT-style refinement) and the empirical rationale for retaining Cached-MNRL-only adaptation as the preferred configuration. To support reproducible model selection, we define a broader evaluation framework comprising standard information retrieval metrics (Recall@K, mean reciprocal rank, nDCG) under the exact hybrid-retrieval protocol; the metrics used for the evaluation reported in this paper are fine-tuning convergence diagnostics and a batch comparative evaluation using the deployed AI-Match score and an independent LLM-as-a-Judge relevance score, and we state this scope explicitly rather than implying the full framework was measured. The paper addresses the gap between general-purpose embedding benchmarks and enterprise job-candidate matching constraints, providing a structured basis for comparing embedding strategies under realistic job-candidate retrieval conditions.
papers.summary: 研究在职位与简历匹配中结合结构化文本、EmbeddingGemma 和全文检索，并以 Cached MNRL 微调向量模型。微调后内部 AI-Match 均值从 52.7 升至 73.5，但独立 LLM 评分超过 80 的比例仅从 43.8% 升至 45.6%。作者明确区分分数尺度变化与相关性提升，未将完整索引上的 nDCG 作为已完成实验。
papers.key_insight: 社区召回微调后，相似度整体上移可能只是训练目标改变了分数分布，不能据此判断检索改善。应冻结独立人工标注集，在同一候选空间比较 Recall 和 nDCG，并额外检查高精度区间及负例分布。结构化输入与编码器更换的贡献也需要拆开，避免把多项工程变更的收益都归给微调。

papers.title: Scoring With the Engine: Retrieval Exposure, Cross-Engine Divergence, and the Limits of Engine-Agnostic GEO Scores
papers.abstract: Abstract: Recent work asks whether generative-engine visibility can be approximated with deterministic, engine-free page scores. We separate two stages such scores can conflate: exposure to a live engine and citation selection conditional on exposure. In an observational audit of ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Google, and Perplexity, 15 fixed commercial prompts produced 589 citation observations on 6 June 2026, corresponding to 528 unique URLs and 356 domains. Same-prompt cross-engine URL overlap was extremely small: mean pairwise Jaccard similarity was 0.0079, the median was zero, and 84.9% of engine pairs shared no cited URL. On the ten prompts observed on all four engines, mean exact-URL Jaccard was 0.0072. A matched-size hypergeometric baseline preserving each prompt's four-engine URL universe and each engine's list length predicts 0.1272, so observed overlap was only 5.7% of that baseline; zero URL overlap occurred in 86.7% of comparisons versus 12.3% expected. Top-five exact-URL overlap was zero in all 60 pairwise comparisons. A single engine captured only 11.4%-42.6% of the four-engine URL union, and 96.4% of observed URLs appeared in only one engine. A separate 5-to-6 June same-engine comparison found 67.0% mean URL-set turnover. These results do not invalidate engine-free page scoring; they identify its estimand. A score computed without a live engine can estimate page quality or query-page fit, while end-to-end visibility additionally depends on engine-specific exposure and selection. We therefore argue for reporting page fit, observed exposure, conditional selection, and final visibility as distinct quantities.
papers.summary: 论文区分页面相关性、引擎曝光与被引用选择，使用 15 个商业提示审计 4 个实时 AI 搜索系统。589 次引用涉及 528 个 URL，同提示跨引擎 URL 集合的平均 Jaccard 仅为 0.0079，84.9% 的引擎对没有重合引用。实验是固定日期的观察性审计，不能据此推断检索算法或因果关系。
papers.key_insight: 评估社区内容在 AI 搜索中的表现时，可同时记录候选曝光、重排入选、上下文保留与最终引用，避免只用页面得分解释流量。检索评测最好固定查询、采样时刻和输出长度，并报告波动；引用只是可见输出，不能完全代表内部候选池。跨引擎差异提示覆盖面问题，但并不直接证明某个引擎相关性更优。

papers.title: ABAI at COLIEE 2026 Task 1: Multi-Stage Retrieval with GraphRAG-Enhanced Meta-Learning, and a Post-Hoc Study of the Cross-Validation-to-Test Gap
papers.authors: Minhan Cho, Soyoung Park, Daejin Choi, Jinyoung Han
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.26237v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We present the ABAI submission to COLIEE 2026 Task 1, case law retrieval, together with a controlled study of why it underperformed. The task suppresses the cited passages themselves, which removes much of the lexical overlap a retriever would rely on. Our pipeline answers this with four independently trained stages: multi-view BM25 over citation-context windows with reciprocal rank fusion, neural reranking, graph-based features from entity communities and a graph attention network, and a LightGBM meta-learner over 34 features. Our best run reached F1=0.177 on the official test set, against a cross-validated 0.311, and we attributed that gap to a recall ceiling, temporal distribution shift, and threshold miscalibration. We then tested all three. Under leakage-free protocols threshold transfer costs 0.007 F1, decision quality is flat across chronological quartiles, and the official test queries are not measurably farther from the training
papers.summary: ABAI 将多视角 BM25、神经重排、图特征与 34 维 LightGBM 元学习器用于法律案例检索。交叉验证 F1 为 0.311，官方测试仅 0.177；后续无泄漏分析发现漏召回和候选排序截断各占一半。BM25 长度归一化、事件三元组与稠密融合使 top-200 召回增加 3–7 个百分点，图特征带来 0.014 F1。
papers.key_insight: 社区检索出现离线与线上落差时，可先按“未入候选”和“入候选但被截断”分解失败，再决定补召回还是改排序。论文复查后削弱了时间漂移和阈值失配解释，提醒团队用受控实验检验直觉。图特征需要排除答案引用泄漏；法律长文结论迁移到短文本前，还需重做负例和候选深度分析。

papers.title: Algebraic Retrieval: Composable Search for Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract: Algebraic Retrieval lets AI agents compose search strategies at query time. Relevance criteria, eligibility constraints, and ranking preferences can be expressed together in a mathematical query. The query surface exposes available operations, so an agent can combine them for the question at hand and revise a program after inspecting results. We evaluate execution parity, not agent behavior or retrieval quality. Building on Programmatic Embedding Modulation (PEM), which exposes vector and score arithmetic during retrieval, we demonstrate contrastive scoring, candidate-pool reranking, and weighted ranking as composable queries, alongside executable SQL and PyTerrier counterparts. On the public 11,429-document Vaswani fixture, each program's implementations select the same document set with score differences below 1e-6; one tied pair orders differently across scoring paths.
papers.summary: Algebraic Retrieval 将相关性、过滤约束与排序偏好表达为可组合数学查询，并给出 SQL 和 PyTerrier 对应实现。基于 11429 篇文档的 Vaswani 数据集，各实现选出相同文档集合，得分差异低于 1e-6，仅一对同分文档顺序不同。实验验证的是执行等价性，没有证明 Agent 行为或检索质量得到提升。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索可借鉴显式查询组合方式，把地域、时间和内容类型等约束与向量打分分开表达，便于重放与审计。落地前应检查过滤语义、同分顺序及浮点误差，并补上人工相关性和延迟测试。这里的可复现证据支持跨执行器语义一致，而不是支持更高 nDCG；模型自动生成查询的可靠性仍需单独评估。

papers.title: Benchmark Radar: A Living Database and Search Engine for AI Benchmarks and Evaluation
papers.authors: Koutian Wu, Junjie Zhou, Ergan Shang, Jiayu Wang, Pengqian Han, Junkai Wang, Wanghan Xu, Songyuanyi Lu, Lin Shi
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.11115v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Benchmark researchers and developers of large language models (LLMs) and other AI systems need to find relevant evaluations, locate their benchmark datasets and code, and understand the settings behind reported scores. We present Benchmark Radar, a living database and search engine for retrieval and discovery of AI benchmarks, covering LLM evaluation, agentic and tool-use benchmarks, coding, reasoning, safety, and domain-specific evaluations. The system combines daily discovery of benchmark papers, repositories, datasets, and releases with a searchable benchmark catalog, mentions in model cards and technical reports, and score histories. It retains source identities and citations so readers can inspect candidate benchmarks and their evaluation evidence. Daily discovery draws on 37 sources: 13 direct connectors and 24 first-party research and engineering feeds. The catalog contains 1,283 source records drawn from 4 benchmark cat
papers.summary: Benchmark Radar 构建持续更新的 AI 基准目录和检索入口，连接论文、代码、数据与模型报告中的评分证据。系统从 37 个来源每日发现内容，目录含 1283 条来源记录，并在 790 条记录上整理 12916 个数值观测。它保留来源身份和引用，提供检索、分数历史及帕累托视图，但这些规模数字不等于搜索质量提升。
papers.key_insight: 对社区知识搜索，值得借鉴的是把内容实体、版本、引用和数值证据关联起来，使用户能够追溯答案。可在问答或技术帖垂类试验来源聚合、去重和版本筛选，再用 nDCG 与查证耗时衡量收益。不同评测设置的分数不能直接混排；本文主要是系统与数据审计贡献，缺少与社区检索基线的直接效果对比。
